column1: # Juxing glyphlette registry -- one line per issued glyphlette, in cell order.
# Written by `juxing.py issue`. Cells are permanent: never renumber or delete lines.
# A retired cell (`juxing.py retire`) keeps its line, with '-' for the glyphlette, and is
# given to the next glyphlette issued.
# id = cell number (sheet = id // 1024, row-major within the sheet)
